title: Zero-days, a verdict and a retention change: the bill arrived on three fronts
summary: Citrix patched two NetScaler flaws rated 9.5 under CVSS v4 that had already been exploited against unmitigated deployments, a reminder that edge appliances carry the blast radius of the services behind them. In New Mexico a jury found Facebook liable for deceptive privacy claims, counting more than 43 million violations of state law before a 1 October penalty hearing. GitHub's Copilot consolidation carried a quieter term: chat data on github.com moves from 28-day retention to the life of the account, and opting out costs access to the product.
